podcasts.title: 382 - Wildwood
podcasts.transcript: This episode takes a new approach! We talk with the sound team behind the new Laika Studios, stop motion animated film, Wildwood.... while they are still in the process of mixing the film!? All their decisions are fresh in their minds as they have been mixing the climatic battle sequence leading right up our conversation. Re-recording Mixers Mike Prestwood Smith and Gilbert Lake are joined by supervising sound editors Luke Gentry and Ben Meechan, as well as Dialog/ADR editor Danny Sheehan, Sound Designer Chris Howard and Supervising Music Editor Mark Wilsher. They all sit around the the mixing console with me, at Goldcrest's Theatre One in London, to discuss the challenges this extremely complicated film presented. ______ Come out to Audio Post MX in Mexico City on Oct 29th!
